rainfall_risk_engine.rationale: Mathematically verified IMD intensity rules, multi-window surge checks, and quality-discounted confidence. 21/21 checks passing. Transparent, explainable, and deterministic.
rainfall_risk_engine.advisory_constraints: Advisory only; distance penalty applies beyond 15km; missing data returns UNKNOWN.

image_quality_gate.rationale: Deterministic filter that reliably rejects blurry, pitch-black, and whiteout glare imagery before inference.
image_quality_gate.advisory_constraints: Must be run as a mandatory pre-filter before any vision model invocation.

mobilenet_v3_small_v3_monsoon.rationale: Best-performing vision checkpoint under weather perturbations (96.85% under rain blur; 100% dry road specificity; 98.36% wet pothole specificity; calibration ECE = 0.0237).
mobilenet_v3_small_v3_monsoon.advisory_constraints: Restricted strictly to shadow/advisory mode with human-in-the-loop verification. Cannot autonomously trigger road closures or dispatch due to source-label confounding.

road_vulnerability_engine.rationale: Multi-criteria spatial heuristic. Transparent civil engineering baseline. Not trained ML; fitting an ML model to it is rule distillation without empirical validity.
road_vulnerability_engine.advisory_constraints: Represents static physical susceptibility, NOT active flooding.

mobilenet_v3_small_v3_clean.rationale: Valid clean split baseline (97.30% acc), but superseded by V3 Monsoon which demonstrates superior robustness under rain blur and headlight glare.

metadata_shortcut_classifier_rf.rationale: Diagnostic tool proving source confounding (85.97% test accuracy on non-semantic metadata alone).
metadata_shortcut_classifier_rf.advisory_constraints: Never to be used as a flood detector.

corridor_susceptibility_analysis.rationale: Exploratory spatial analysis of 20 Hyderabad corridors.
corridor_susceptibility_analysis.advisory_constraints: Must not be cited as predictive flood risk.

telemetry_continuity_diagnostics.rationale: Exploratory profiling of regional rain gauge transmission gaps and accumulator confusion.
telemetry_continuity_diagnostics.advisory_constraints: Confirms telemetry is currently unviable for continuous hourly forecasting.

mobilenet_v3_small_v1.rationale: Historical checkpoint trained on leaky, biased web scrape with arbitrary non-road images.

mobilenet_v3_small_v2.rationale: Collapses to 53.15% accuracy on Test V3 with 94.0% False Positive Rate on unseen dry asphalt. Learned thumbnail resolution shortcut.

vision_v4_production_deep_model.rationale: Production training blocked by readiness gate (Cramer's V = 1.0000; 0 multi-class road imagery sources; 0 real field observations).
vision_v4_production_deep_model.advisory_constraints: Will be unlocked only when genuine matched road imagery is acquired under pilot collection.

supervised_flood_occurrence_prediction.rationale: Zero ground-truth flood outcome observations exist. Static KML placemarks are chronic locations without timestamps or depths.
supervised_flood_occurrence_prediction.advisory_constraints: Will be unlocked only when >=50 verified flood episodes and >=100 non-flood episodes across >=4 storm dates are collected.

short_term_hourly_rainfall_forecasting.rationale: Telemetry suffers from >90% temporal missingness, 141-day gaps, 50.82% bucket accumulator counters, and zero stations in the GHMC urban core.
short_term_hourly_rainfall_forecasting.advisory_constraints: Will be unlocked only when continuous 15-minute urban AWS telemetry with >=98% uptime is deployed.
